chapters.title: Why there is no voice
chapters.say: Your video has no voice this time. Here is why, and how to fix it.

scenes.heading: The voice model could not be downloaded
scenes.sub: About 350 MB, fetched once from a GitHub release.

items.title: Allow downloads from github.com
items.detail: The model comes from a GitHub release

items.title: Or fetch the two files yourself

beats.say: The voice is a model of about three hundred and fifty megabytes, downloaded once. This time, the download was blocked.
If you can, allow downloads from GitHub.
Or download the two model files yourself,
and put them in this folder.
Until then, you get a silent version with captions.
